searchText: It was conceived before those existed, but the essence in 8077 is recognising the fact that sharing metadata that is not just a random ID (the hash) makes a difference from the receiver's perspective. Nonce fits in this concept in all shapes and forms. I was working on an update during last week, but it takes some time (also because of other PQ prios).
